# Pro Link Systems

> Managed IT services, cybersecurity, and cloud solutions for Los Angeles businesses since 1999. Based in Woodland Hills, CA, with a 24/7 in-house, US-based help desk, serving organizations across healthcare, legal, finance, manufacturing, aerospace, and more.

Pro Link Systems is a managed IT services provider (MSP) serving the greater Los Angeles area. Founded in 1999 by Brian Shad and headquartered in Woodland Hills, the company delivers flat-rate managed IT with unlimited support, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, backup and disaster recovery, AI automation, and a 24/7 help desk staffed by real engineers - with no long-term contracts.

- Address: 21241 Ventura Blvd #193, Woodland Hills, CA 91364
- Phone: 1-800-890-6133
- Email: info@prolinksystems.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM Pacific (24/7 help desk for managed clients)
- Founded: 1999 (25+ years in business)
- Service area: Greater Los Angeles - San Fernando Valley, West LA, the South Bay, the San Gabriel Valley, the Conejo Valley and Ventura County, and Orange County
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCm0_oUdW9jLC_HX7pxpIAWA

## Key Facts

- Help desk: 24/7, in-house and US-based. Phone calls are answered live by the in-house team - no phone tree, no hold queue.
- Average ticket first-response time: 15 minutes.
- First-contact resolution: 90%. Average resolution time: under one hour.
- Managed IT plans include unlimited support at a flat monthly rate, with no long-term contracts.
- Same-day on-site support when needed, from the Woodland Hills office.
- Backups are verified by restore testing, not assumed from job reports.
- Pro Link Systems signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with its healthcare clients.
- For compliance assessments and audits, Pro Link works alongside the client's compliance advisor and handles the IT side.
- The incident-response playbook is published free and ungated (no form, no email required).

## Services

- [Managed IT Services](https://prolinksystems.com/managed-it-services): Flat-rate managed IT for LA businesses - proactive monitoring, 24/7 help desk, unlimited support, same-day on-site support when needed, no long-term contracts.
- [Cybersecurity Services](https://prolinksystems.com/cybersecurity-services): EDR, email security, 24/7 SOC monitoring, and ransomware and phishing defense.
- [Cloud Services](https://prolinksystems.com/cloud-services): Microsoft 365, Azure, cloud migration, virtual desktops, and managed cloud infrastructure.
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://prolinksystems.com/backup-disaster-recovery): Automated backups, ransomware recovery, tested failover, and business continuity planning.
- [24/7 IT Help Desk](https://prolinksystems.com/it-help-desk): Round-the-clock support answered live by our in-house, US-based team; average ticket first-response time is 15 minutes.
- [AI & Automation Services](https://prolinksystems.com/ai-automation-services): AI knowledge assistants, workflow automation, Microsoft Copilot deployment, and custom AI solutions.
- [Outsourced IT Services](https://prolinksystems.com/outsourced-it-services-los-angeles): Replace an in-house IT department with a flat-rate team of local engineers, ideal for businesses with 5 to 100 employees.
- [Co-Managed IT Services](https://prolinksystems.com/co-managed-it-services): Augment an existing internal IT person or team with 24/7 help desk overflow, SOC-backed cybersecurity, cloud, backup, and vCIO strategy - we extend your team, not replace it.
- [Microsoft 365 Support](https://prolinksystems.com/microsoft-365-support-los-angeles): Microsoft 365 setup, migration, and management - Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Azure AD, security hardening, and licensing optimization.
- [Network Support & Management](https://prolinksystems.com/network-support-los-angeles): 24/7 network monitoring, business WiFi design, firewall, VPN, and network security across the LA metro.
- [Virtual CIO (vCIO) & IT Consulting](https://prolinksystems.com/virtual-cio): Fractional CIO leadership for LA businesses - strategic technology planning, budgeting, security strategy, and vendor management.
- [All Services Overview](https://prolinksystems.com/services): Full summary of Pro Link Systems' IT service offerings.

## Cybersecurity

- [Email Security](https://prolinksystems.com/email-security-services): Advanced email threat protection beyond standard spam filtering.
- [Endpoint Security](https://prolinksystems.com/endpoint-security-services): EDR/MDR and managed protection for laptops, desktops, and servers.
- [Network Security](https://prolinksystems.com/network-security-services): Firewalls, segmentation, and managed network defense.
- [Identity & Access Management](https://prolinksystems.com/identity-access-management): MFA, single sign-on, and least-privilege access control.
- [Security Awareness Training](https://prolinksystems.com/security-awareness-training): Phishing simulation and employee security training.
- [IT Governance & Risk Management](https://prolinksystems.com/governance-risk-compliance): IT policies, technology risk reviews, security roadmaps, and business-continuity planning.

## Industries Served

- [Healthcare IT](https://prolinksystems.com/healthcare-it-services): IT support for medical and dental practices: EHR uptime, secure devices and email, and restore-tested backups. Pro Link signs a BAA with its healthcare clients.
- [Law Firm IT](https://prolinksystems.com/law-firm-it-services-los-angeles): Secure document management, remote access, and 24/7 support for law firms.
- [Financial Services IT](https://prolinksystems.com/financial-services-it): Managed IT for RIAs, wealth managers, CPAs, and insurers: BEC and wire-fraud defense, tested backups, and a 24/7 in-house help desk.
- [Manufacturing IT](https://prolinksystems.com/manufacturing-it-services): OT/IT-integrated IT for manufacturers: plant networks, ERP uptime, and a 24/7 help desk.
- [Aerospace & Defense IT](https://prolinksystems.com/aerospace-defense-it-services): IT support for aerospace and defense suppliers: engineering workstations and secure, segmented networks.
- [Real Estate IT](https://prolinksystems.com/real-estate-it-services): Wire-fraud defense and IT for brokerages and property management.
- [Professional Services IT](https://prolinksystems.com/professional-services-it): Scalable IT for consulting, accounting, and professional firms.
- [Nonprofit IT](https://prolinksystems.com/nonprofit-it-services): Managed IT for nonprofits and foundations: Microsoft 365 Nonprofit setup, help accessing donated and discounted technology, donor-data security, and a 24/7 help desk.
- [Technology & SaaS IT](https://prolinksystems.com/technology-it-services): Secure cloud, identity, and endpoint management for tech companies.
- [Entertainment & Media IT](https://prolinksystems.com/entertainment-it-services): Content security, post-production workstation support, shared media storage, and backup for studios and media companies.
- [Education IT](https://prolinksystems.com/education-it-services): School IT for private and charter schools: content filtering, student-data security, classroom technology, and campus Wi-Fi.
- [Logistics IT](https://prolinksystems.com/logistics-it-services): WMS/TMS, warehouse Wi-Fi, and EDI support for logistics and warehousing.
- [Waste Management IT](https://prolinksystems.com/waste-management-it-services): Fleet, scale-house, and critical-infrastructure IT for waste companies.

## Guides

- [Why Choose Pro Link Systems](https://prolinksystems.com/why-pro-link-systems): How Pro Link compares to national MSPs and break-fix IT - flat-rate pricing, 24/7 local engineers, no long-term contracts, serving LA since 1999. Includes a side-by-side comparison table and client testimonials.
- [How to Choose a Managed IT Provider in Los Angeles](https://prolinksystems.com/how-to-choose-managed-it-provider-los-angeles): Buyer's guide - what to look for, red flags to avoid, and the questions to ask before hiring a managed IT company in LA.
- [Managed IT Services Pricing in Los Angeles (2026)](https://prolinksystems.com/managed-it-services-pricing-los-angeles): What managed IT costs in Los Angeles - pricing models, typical $75-200 per user per month, and what should be included at each service tier.
- [Los Angeles Business Cybersecurity Report 2026](https://prolinksystems.com/la-business-cybersecurity-report-2026): The state of cybersecurity for LA businesses in 2026 - top threats (ransomware, BEC, phishing), industry-specific risk by sector, compliance frameworks (HIPAA, PCI DSS, CMMC, SOC 2, CCPA), an industry-benchmark data table, and an 8-point security checklist. Benchmark figures are sourced and attributed to IBM, the Verizon DBIR, and the FBI IC3.
- [What Does a vCIO Do?](https://prolinksystems.com/what-does-a-vcio-do): A virtual CIO owns technology planning, budgeting, roadmap, security strategy, vendor management, and technology risk planning for a business.
- [When Your Business Needs a vCIO](https://prolinksystems.com/when-your-business-needs-a-vcio): The growth stages and warning signs that call for strategic IT leadership, budgeting, and a technology roadmap.
- [vCIO vs. Break-Fix vs. Managed IT](https://prolinksystems.com/vcio-vs-break-fix-vs-managed-it): What each IT model covers, where each costs more than it looks, and how strategy and operations fit together.
